hebrewText: וַ/יֹּ֖אמֶר אֵלָ֑/י אֵ֚לֶּה בֵּ֣ית הַֽ/מְבַשְּׁלִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֧ר יְבַשְּׁלוּ שָׁ֛ם מְשָׁרְתֵ֥י הַ/בַּ֖יִת אֶת זֶ֥בַח הָ/עָֽם

tokens.bdb: properly, self (but generally used to point out more definitely the object of a verb or preposition, even or namely)
properly, a slaughter, i.e. the flesh of an animal; by implication, a sacrifice (the victim or the act)
a people (as a congregated unit); specifically, a tribe (as those of Israel); hence (collectively) troops or attendants; figuratively, a flock
